title: Kai and the Dawgs: The League's Sharpest Football Mind, Still Waiting for the Scoreboard to Agree
body: Mekhi has run the Dawgs since the Buckaroo Football League's founding in 2023, and no franchise has more loyalty to a name. He arrived as arguably the league's most knowledgeable football mind, and he went 6-8 in Year One, scraping into the 4 seed and finishing 4th of 6. That season set the template: 1542.8 points, zero trades, and 9 waiver pickups, the first sign that Kai trusts the wire more than he trusts any of his friends.

2024 was a step back, with a 5-9 record, a 5 seed, and a 5th-place finish on 1413.5 points. The low point came in Week 14, when the Dawgs put up just 67.9 against Randy, still the worst week of Mekhi's career. Then came 2025, the strangest season in Dawgs history. Mekhi drafted from basic training, went 8-8, posted a career-high 1858.2 points, and dropped a franchise-record 153.6 on Randy in Week 9 for revenge. He made his first-ever trade and earned the 4 seed, then lost his only career playoff game and slid down the consolation ladder into last place. A .500 team with its best scoring year ending up in the basement is the kind of fantasy cruelty only a true football guy could earn.

The head-to-head ledger tells the rest. Randy is the Dawgs' true rival at a dead-even 6-6, the opponent behind both Mekhi's best and worst nights. Kaushal is the nightmare: Habib owns Kai 2-9, the most lopsided matchup on his record. He trails Sonny 5-7, Alan 4-6, and Brucie 3-6, but he's a perfect 1-0 against both newcomers, JMoney and Zilgit, so the Dawgs are at least handling the rookies.

Which brings us to 2026, where Mekhi drafted from overseas, extending his streak of terrible draft-day timing. The Dawgs sit at 2-5 with 736 points and 1% title odds. As usual, he isn't sitting still: 8 pickups and a trade already, matching his pickup totals from full seasons. The waiver-wire king is working his kingdom harder than ever, and the league knows the most dangerous Dawgs team might be the one that finally gets a full draft day at home.
